title: T2 mismatch/corrupt/no-golden branches + diff-bundle writer (the PR's own allocator + JSON fixes) have zero automated exercise
detail: All 8 demos pass, so the mismatch/corrupt/no-golden branches and diff-bundle writer never run in CI (harness has zero @(test) procs). Two latent bugs the PR fixes — old diff.json emitted %!(MISSING CLOSE BRACE)... invalid JSON — shipped unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Exercise the mismatch path in CI: a test that tampers a blessed golden and asserts the run fails with a valid diff.json/REPORT (plus corrupt-golden and no-golden branches).

title: New directive error paths (bad spawn_node/fixture lines, unknown node type, run-setup-failed) exercised by nothing; parse-error returns leak cloned type_name strings
detail: Bad spawn_node/fixture lines, unknown node types, and the run-setup-failed rejection are exercised by no demo, drift mutation, or unit test (drift only mutates log bytes). Parse-error returns also leak cloned type_name strings — run_demo's cleanup defer sits after the error check.
recommended_fix: Add parse_demo unit tests for malformed spawn_node/fixture lines and a lower_nodes unknown-type test; free cloned type_name strings on the parse-error return path.

title: spawn_node coordinates silently accept negatives and i32-wrap out-of-range values — no fail-loud bounds check, untested
detail: No bounds check: negatives parse (parse_int) and out-of-i32 values silently wrap — verified i32(3000000000) = -1294967296 — while draw/spawn endpoints use parse_uint. A typo'd coordinate becomes a garbage off-grid node instead of failing loud.
recommended_fix: Reject out-of-range coordinates at parse (clamp or fail loud, mirroring parse_uint usage for draw endpoints) and pin the boundary with a test.

title: Fixture-on + spawn_node combined numbering ('fixture ids 0..2, entries follow at 3..') unexercised at the harness level
detail: The documented fixture-on + spawn_node numbering ('fixture occupies ids 0..2, entries follow at 3..') is exercised by no demo — ecmp is the only spawn_node demo and it is `fixture off`; only the core-level analog (demolish_test's 4th node = id 3) pins the claim.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture-on demo (or harness unit test) with spawn_node entries asserting ids 3.., exercising the documented combined numbering.

detail: P0 paths 2-4 fully covered (verified live: 8/8 demos T1+T2+replay, drift 47/47, odin 54/54). P0 path 1's pass side covered, but its mismatch/corrupt/no-golden branches and diff-bundle writer are 0% exercised; parse-error paths 0%. Overall ≈85%, P1 ≈85%.
